name: Seal of the Land's Riches (Vật Hoa Ấn)
lore: The auction's hammer and seal in one: a red-gold block cut from the first Xích Kim nugget (A176). Every lot sold at Vật Hoa Thị since 1050 has been sealed with it at the fall of the hammer (A185). Buyers say a lot it has sealed cannot be stolen without the thief's luck turning.
build_use: The mistress's Metal engine: heavy, lasting Metal stacks spent all at once.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: The Grown Red Pearl (Ôn Dưỡng Xích Châu)
lore: A grain of Xích Kim red gold that Phan Vật Hoa set in her own dantian in 750 with the Warm-Nurtured Treasure Sutra and has fed for 450 years. It is the size of a plum now and has never been out of her. It is the one thing in Thiên Bảo Trai that has no price. No one has seen it.
build_use: Health, thần thức and one bought death.

name: Red Gold Furnace Apron (Xích Kim Lô Giáp)
lore: A smith's apron of linked red-gold scale, worn at the Xích Kim furnace by three generations of the studio's first refiners. It is scorched black at the hem and has never let a spark through.
build_use: A refiner's armour: health, fire resistance and a slow, steady guard.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Mirror of the Third Price (Đệ Tam Giá Kính)
lore: The appraiser's mirror of the auction floor, polished red gold that shows a thing's flaw as a dark thread. Ung Thiên Kim gave it to her the day she priced the broken sword.
build_use: The eye: Metal stacks and the crit that finds a flaw.

name: Red Gold Furnace Sword (Xích Kim Lô Kiếm)
lore: A flying sword of red gold he refined for himself in 1100 and never put up for auction. The mistress has asked its price three times.
build_use: A refiner's strike: artifact damage from a thing he made.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Crucible Lid Shield (Dã Lô Cái Thuẫn)
lore: The lid of the great crucible of Xích Kim, cracked in 1088 and kept as a shield. He lifts it off the furnace with his bare arm.
build_use: The furnace body: block and fire kept out.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
